description: Accounts in Arabic script and Greek/Coptic numerals. Mentions al-muʿallim Ṣāliḥ; the cantor al-Mesos (المسوس الحزان); Hārūn ʿAbd al-Qawiyy; al-ʿAjamī; "In Cairo"; al-Baṣīr(?); Abū l-Ḥasan al-Mubayyiḍ; mentions flax; Ismāʿīl al-Ghazalī the acquaintance of ʿAbd al-Bāqī;Ibrāhīm the brother of ʿAbd al-Qawiyy; ʿAbd al-Wahhāb al-Ḥaffār; ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz "in his dwellling in Zuqāq al-Ruqyānī(?)."
